No forced password reset appears for the migrated account.

No corrupted or blank mandatory profile fields are observed.

MATRIX_ROWS.Evidence Notes: Story excludes password transfer but Epic intent requires successful credential continuity post-migration.
MATRIX_ROWS.Inconsistencies: Credential continuity depends on dedicated password-hash mapping story and environment setup.

MATRIX_ROWS.Evidence Notes: Scenario 2 and 3 define no-duplicate behavior and conditional update logic based on export timing.
